purpose: Cumulative scientific and operational priors; distinguish evidence type and repeat sources
scientific_grades_0_to_3: All 0/3 for novel PFL scientific discovery. A few useful engineering outputs are not substantive 1/3 scientific.
selection_exposure: C02-C05 all use the same ForecastBench public leaderboard; multiple exploratory descriptive contrasts not independent replication

entries.claim: Sequential small mock assignment seeds do not introduce noticeable positional pattern
entries.limits: Repaired seed avalanche is deterministic and not secure human randomization. Future holdout required.

entries.claim: Complete-case factorial effect remains ITT when a fictional outcome missing
entries.limits: Synthetic bounds; no observed human outcomes.

entries.claim: Local mock status APPROVED_BY_HUMAN_REVIEW is proof of real ethical consent
entries.limits: Demonstrated arbitrary review_ref accepted; never count as human approval.

entries.claim: Existing public forecasting leaderboard category rank is stable across categories
entries.limits: One public aggregate table reused in multiple exploratory tests; categories represent different task types and samples.

entries.claim: Tournament leaderboard always improves education or participation
entries.limits: External educational studies not PFL causal evidence.

entries.claim: Naive arithmetic mean of category Index scores equals published Overall Index in ForecastBench
entries.limits: Aggregation transformation already published; not a new PFL method.

entries.claim: GitHub connector cannot inspect all Atlas update file metadata without full checkout
entries.limits: 80 JSON parsed, 79 parent links valid; Python strict graph replay still absent.

entries.claim: HTTP server being accessible from Python/Playwright API means Chromium can navigate same localhost
entries.limits: Policy is environmental. No attempt to bypass.

entries.claim: Public question+resolution sets alone prove exposure of individual forecasters
entries.limits: 2.7MB source input inaccessible; even full public question list is not person-specific visibility.

entries.claim: PFL has a new experimentally established human leaderboard effect
entries.limits: 0 independent PFL human results, no randomized allocation and no causal estimate.

data_rights: ForecastBench CC BY-SA 4.0 public aggregate data only; human individual files not inspected
next_discriminant_evidence: Observable preregistered exposure/assignment data from ethically approved study or independently licensed experiment with matching estimand
